info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Assigns-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Assignment Management API provides tools for retrieving a list of support tickets that have been assigned to agents. This API is essential for customer support teams to monitor workload distribution and ensure timely responses to customer inquiries. Typical users include support representatives and team leads who need to oversee assigned tickets and manage team performance. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their customer service operations and streamline ticket management processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of tickets that can be assigned to users. It's essential for managing ticket allocation efficiently and ensures that users can access tickets based on their responsibilities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to assign a ticket to a specific user. It should contain information about the ticket ID and the user ID to whom the ticket will be assigned.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to ticket assignment. It is expected to be a string.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsResponse_204.title: Ticket Assignment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket assignment operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for tracking the ticket assignment.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the ticket assignment operation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket assignment process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the ticket assignment request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the ticket assignment operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the ticket assignment operation.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsResponse_204.description: Response schema for the ticket assignment operation, indicating the result of the request.
